subject: The secret mistake 90% of users make
preview_text: I discovered a user who turned our AI into a personal trainer scout. This changes everything about jockey form.
body_paragraphs: Got a confession. I was reviewing user data last week and found something that made me stop. One user isn't just checking our AI picks before a race. He's using the jockey form analysis feature to scout talent for his fantasy racing league. Every. Single. Day.

Turns out, our deep jockey performance metrics—win rates on specific track conditions, distance proficiency, even how they handle wet vs dry turf—are a goldmine for spotting rising stars before bookmakers adjust the odds. He identified three jockeys in Australia who were undervalued by the market, purely by tracking their 'confidence score' progression in our app over six weeks.

This works because our AI doesn't just look at last week's win. It analyzes thousands of variables on jockey form, creating a predictive trendline most punters never see. It's like having a crystal ball for which jockey is about to go on a hot streak, at Cheltenham, Ascot, or anywhere we cover.

Open the app. Go to any racecard. Tap on a jockey's name and scroll past the basic stats. Look at the form graph and the condition-specific ratings. That's where the hidden value lives. Try it on one race today. P.S. The user who does this? He only uses Premium because he needs unlimited access to all that historical jockey data. Smart guy.
